# telnyx_storage_kv_key (Resource)

A key and its value in a KV namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_storage_kv_namespace" "example" {
  name = "feature-flags"
}

resource "telnyx_storage_kv_key" "example" {
  namespace_id = telnyx_storage_kv_namespace.example.id
  key          = "new-checkout"
  value        = jsonencode({ enabled = true, rollout = 0.1 })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key id.
- `namespace_id` (String) The namespace id.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The value, stored as UTF-8 text.

### Optional

- `ttl_secs` (Number) Seconds until the key expires and is removed. Sent when the value is written; by default the key never expires.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_storage_kv_key.example <namespace_id>/<key>
```
